extract_protocol_ch1: The PBMCs were isolated using the Stemcell EasySep™ Direct Human PBMC Isolation Kit. The isolated PBMCs were frozen in ice-cold cryopreservation solution – 50% FBS/40% growth media/10% DMSO
10x genomic library preparing for snRNA and snATAC
data_processing: Single nuclei RNA sequencing data processing and analysis started with raw data from PBMCs generated via the 10x Genomic Chromium platform. ‘cellranger-arc’ (version: 2.0.2) and ‘cellranger’ (version: 7.1.0) software were used to perform read alignment, low-quality read filtration, barcode counting, and UMI tallying, consistently applying default parameters.
Assembly: hg38
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-seperated value files and matrix files
contact_department: Center for developmental biology and regenerative medicine

metadata.source_specimen: Nuclei from frozen PBMC isolated by source direct PBMC isolation kit
metadata.source_assay: RNA branch of single-nucleus RNA/ATAC multiome
metadata.source_identity_policy: Four source participant codes, four deposited RNA visits each. Repeated visits share donor UID. Non-RNA assays and THP-1 cell-line experiments do not add clinical participants or samples.
metadata.source_time_policy: Source nominal pre/end/8h/24h CPB collection labels retained. Exact individual draw dates and times not independently joined.
metadata.source_assay_policy: Source design reports nuclear RNA for all sixteen PBMC-derived samples. Four patient02 filenames contain scRNA but are not evidence for whole-cell collection. Nuclear versus whole-cell measurement differences require downstream study/assay audit.
metadata.source_modality_policy: All native values validated before selecting typed Gene Expression features. Peak counts do not enter RNA totals, detected genes, mitochondrial fractions, annotation or gene centroids. Peak-only fragments and other assays not acquired.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Paper reports a neonatal cohort; individual age, sex, cardiac diagnosis and bypass duration not independently joined. Cohort-level demographics are not assigned to individual sources.
metadata.source_processing_policy: Source-filtered count matrices retain original RNA genes and counts. Project RNA QC applied independently; source integration/embedding does not define expression geometry.
